'''Sir Barnabas of Strom''' is a human located at the [[Jousting Grounds]] in [[Northwind]]. One of the participants in the Northwind jousting tournament representing the [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|kingdom of Stromgarde]], he faces off against [[Lumiere of Dalaran]].
